mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuation and increases the present value of future cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.5%, it signals a weak labor market that may prompt monetary easing, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent month-over-month increases in industrial production (INDPRO) and payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate robust economic activity and strong business conditions, supporting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and PAYEMS both increase from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both INDPRO and PAYEMS increase from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (UNRATE < 5.0% and FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), the economy is overheating with high inflation risk, prompting the Fed to tighten policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 5.0% and FEDFUNDS > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand and economic growth, which supports positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 185,000 units.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%, it signals accelerating inflation that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) exceed 350,000 million dollars and industrial production (INDPRO) increases from the prior month, it indicates strong consumer and business demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS > 350000 and INDPRO increases from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS > 350000 and INDPRO increases from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) of at least 0.1% over the past 30 days signals monetary easing, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS decreases by at least 0.1% in the last 30 days.
